name: No Native Dialogs (localised buttons)
note: Capacitor draws window.confirm with hardcoded English OK/Cancel. In a Korean or Arabic build the question is translated and the buttons are not.

mutations.name: a screen calls window.confirm directly
mutations.why: The dialog then asks in the player's language and answers in English. Thirteen locales, one of which is right.

mutations.name: window.alert comes back
mutations.why: External audit V11, and it was live: the regex saw only window.confirm and a bare alert, so this exact call sat in AccountSection.jsx from the first 1v1 commit until 2026-09-30 — English OK button, English message, every language.

mutations.name: a bare prompt()
mutations.why: prompt draws the same native dialog with the same English buttons. It was not in the pattern at all.

mutations.name: globalThis.confirm
mutations.why: The same dialog reached through a different name for the global object. The check reads the call, not the spelling of one path to it.

mutations.name: a comment and a string that mention alert( (control)
mutations.why: The parser reads calls, not text, so explaining the old bug in a comment or naming it in a string must not fail the gate. Without this control the natural fix for a false positive would be to stop writing the explanation down.
